reviews.claim: Manipulating objects with hidden internal state, such as a latched microwave, forces a robot to probe before it can act. Yet a robot that has solved an instance once re-runs the same probes whenever it encounters that instance again, because existing cross-episode memories target task success and organize reuse around states, not the object or the cost of re-exploring it.
